qualified_sealed_carrier.abi_history: V6-V22 used this exact frozen carrier and changed only registered ABI bridges. The best bounded bridge reached 1248/1400 but retained 75 repetition collapses and failed the absolute per-capability gates.
qualified_sealed_carrier.interpretation: Those failures establish insufficiency of the tested ABI bridges, not a regression or mutation of the sealed LayerCake carrier. They do not prove a carrier capacity ceiling because its transition weights were frozen.

construct_only_external_carrier.autonomous_result: 0/17 grammar prefix passes with 15 repetition collapses before monotonic fail-fast
construct_only_external_carrier.interpretation: V322's autonomous failure and subsequent operator-fidelity failures belong to ABI extraction and sequential composition. The LayerCake v16 host physically executed the immutable artifact with exact routing and zero host errors.

closed_architectural_families: frozen small bridges on the sealed three-block carrier
late-only and distributed cached-sequence conformance on V322
direct per-source-layer head, low-rank, structured-support, and nonlinear-unit compression
selected_material_question: Can the teacher-derived, capability-labeled Phase 1 IR compile end to end into the transition dynamics of a derivative copy of the already-qualified three-block LayerCake carrier, without changing its tokenizer, embeddings, positional substrate, architecture, parameter count, or execution graph?

selected_control.name: qualified-three-block-transition-capacity-control
selected_control.trainable_scope: the existing three transformer blocks, final normalization, task classifier, and ten existing task cakes
selected_control.frozen_scope: token embedding/output head and positional embedding
selected_control.reason: This is the smallest direct test of the remaining unproven carrier-capacity ceiling. It compiles behavior across the whole existing LayerCake transition rather than approximating individual source blocks.

decision_rule: Run one development-only fail-fast capacity control at one seed. A failure closes full-transition adaptation on the current 7000-record imported-information budget without nearby optimizer, duration, seed, data, source, decoding, or gate sweeps. A pass authorizes matched causal controls and independent seeds; it does not itself certify Phase 3.
phase2_external_blocker: 21000 blinded judgments from three independent human raters remain unavailable and are not waived.
claim_boundary: Architecture and carrier-identity review only. No new training, quality, runtime, minimum-information, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
